newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Pele becomes father of twins.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Pele becomes father of twins.

text.p: Former Brazilian soccer superstar Pele became the father of twins - one boy and one girl - on Saturday evening, a spokeswoman for the Sao Luiz hospital in Sao Paulo said on Sunday.

The twins, Joshua and Celeste, were born at just over 30 weeks and each weighed just under three pounds (1.30 kg). Doctors had been planning to deliver the babies after Oct. 5 but carried out the emergency Cesarian operation after Pele's wife began to feel pains, the spokeswoman said.
Both mother and babies are doing well, she added.
"The babies are perfect. We are taking the normal precautions as they were born prematurely but everything is fine," Pele, aged 55 and now Brazil's Special Sports Minister, told local radio.
